_comment: HUMAN-OWNED. The autonomous builder must NOT edit this file. Calibrate values to your unit economics.
_token_cap_note: Hard floor. Builder refuses to run once the month's ledger reaches this. Set to your real budget.

seed_scope._note: Expansion: scope widened by human (Rolando) on 2026-06-02 from the original 4 Miami-core neighborhoods to all 40 neighborhoods present in data/prospector/clinics.json (Miami-Dade + Broward + Palm Beach). Many of the new neighborhoods have only 1-2 clinics — the quality gate may still cull thin treatment-x-neighborhood pages. Narrow back later if pages underperform.

state_thresholds._note: Evaluator scores against these to set build_state. Months are since launch.

resume_policy._note: Reversible. Evaluator may auto-resume paused/throttled when signals recover; human may resume anytime.
